evidenceSummary.status: temporary rejected vertex-only baseline; seam-aligned subdivision is required before production use
evidenceSummary.classification: exact source-position H/G0/S0/G1/S1/G2/S2 zones; conservative PBR/normal-recessed seam-core rows inside circumferential geometry traces
evidenceSummary.rigidityRule: smooth chrome positions are rigid; interpolation is confined to authored gasket positions
evidenceSummary.blendSemantics: raw proximal-to-distal local axial seam-core progress t; no easing (the builder applies one smoothstep)
evidenceSummary.thumbG0Caveat: The thumb-to-hand web has no complete visible closed texture ring; only PBR/normal-recessed positions within 3.5 mm of the visible crease remain G0, and all other web/palm positions stay rigid.

validation.directRigidBoundaryPolicy: accepted when a sparse source face itself spans the authored seam; distant smooth-chrome endpoints are never promoted to G
